title: Pure Orcust
summary: Pure Orcust graveyard-link combo deck, featuring the 2025 legacy support alongside generic Link payoffs. Orcust monsters banish themselves from the GY to summon, mill, and swarm DARK Machines, while Orcustrated Babel elevates their graveyard activations into Quick Effects on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight sends an Orcust card from Deck to the GY on summon, and creates a World Legacy Token on both fields if you control no other monsters.
Orcust Harp Horror banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon an Orcust monster from your Deck, locking your Extra Deck summons to DARK monsters.
Orcustrated Return sends an Orcust card from hand or field to the GY to draw two cards.
Orcust Knightmare banishes itself from the GY to send a DARK Machine from Deck to GY and grant an ATK boost.
Orcust Brass Bombard banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon an Orcust monster from your hand.

summary.title: Opening: Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight
steps: Normal Summon Girsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight, activating its effect to send Orcust Harp Horror from your Deck to the GY.
Activate Girsu's effect to Special Summon a World Legacy Token to both players' fields.
Link Girsu and the Token into Galatea, the Orcust Automaton.
Banish Orcust Harp Horror from your GY to Special Summon Orcust Cymbal Skeleton from your Deck.
Activate Galatea, shuffling Harp Horror into the Deck to Set Orcustrated Babel directly from your Deck.
Overlay Galatea into Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star to attach Cymbal Skeleton as material, then activate Orcustrated Babel to make all Orcust effects Quick Effects.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star sends an opponent's card to the GY without targeting on summon or attaches a banished Machine, and detaches a material to protect cards you control from destruction.
Galatea-I, the Orcust Automaton is a Link-1 that searches Orcustrated Babel on Link Summon and can revive itself from the GY.
Enlilgirsu, the Orcust Mekk-Knight is a Link-4 that shuffles two banished Machine monsters into the Deck to take control of an opponent's monster.
Longirsu, the Orcust Orchestrator shuffles two banished Machine monsters into the Deck to send a linked monster to the GY without destruction.
Orcustrion is a Link-4 that shuffles three banished Machine monsters into the Deck to negate the effects of all linked opponent monsters and reduce their ATK/DEF to 0.
I:P Masquerena links into S:P Little Knight or Knightmare Unicorn during the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Orcustrated Babel transforms all monster effects of Orcust Link Monsters on field and Orcust monsters in your GY into Quick Effects.
Orcust Crescendo negates and banishes a Spell/Trap or monster effect while you control an Orcust Link Monster, and banishes itself from the GY to search a DARK Machine.
Orcustrated Return draws two cards by sending an Orcust card to the GY.
Orcustrated Einsatz sends an Orcust monster from Deck to GY whenever the opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.
Orcustrated Core targets an Orcust card you control to make it untargetable for the turn.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: World Legacy auxiliary engines are left out in favor of pure Orcust consistency and dedicated DARK Machine recursion.
